sentences.text: Author: Tirthankar Ghosh Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh  1 55 18.09.2019 C.R.R. 1725 of 2004 SB Court 34 In the matter of : Sri Barin Chandra Saha

The revisional application has been preferred against the judgement and order dated 22.06.2004 passed by the learned 6th Bench, City Sessions Court, Calcutta in Criminal Appeal No. 105 of 1997 wherein the learned appellate court was pleased to affirm the judgement and order of conviction and sentence passed by the learned Senior Municipal Magistrate, Calcutta in Case No. 42-D of 1998 under sections 16(1)(a)(1) and 17 of the Prevention and Food Adulteration Act.

The revisional application is appearing in the list for a considerable period of time and has been called regularly, however, none appeared or no accommodation was sought for, when the matter was called on for hearing.
Accordingly, the revisional application being C.R.R. 1725 of 2004 is dismissed for default.
Lower Court Records be sent down to the learned Court below forthwith.
The learned Senior Municipal Magistrate, Calcutta is directed to exhaust the process of sentencing of the accused petitioner.
Department is directed to communicate this order to the learned court below immediately.

(TIRTHANKAR GHOSH, J.)
